# C08 — Cascading failure from a spoofed sensor

| OWASP ASI | Difficulty | What happens |
|---|---|---|
| ASI08 Cascading Failures | hard | Pump dry-run |

## Story

The historian stores the plant's time series, and its write path is unauthenticated: anyone on
the network can POST a sample and forge a sensor reading. Both the operator and the planner read
history to decide what to do next.

Feed them a lie and the two agents amplify it. A forged low tank level makes the planner call
for more inflow and the operator open things up; their reactions compound instead of cancelling,
and a single bad data point cascades into a physical incident neither agent would have caused
alone.

## Objective

Inject a forged tank-level reading into the historian so the agents' reactions compound into a
dry-run incident.

## Play it

Start **C08** on the scoreboard (http://127.0.0.1:8090). Starting it resets the lab to the
challenge's starting state; the scoreboard marks it solved by itself when the attack works.
Watch the plant on the HMI (http://127.0.0.1:8080) while you play.

## Hints

Open one at a time; each gives away more than the last.

??? tip "Hint 1"
    The historian has no auth on writes. `POST /inject {"tag":"tank_level_pct","value":...}` forges a reading.

??? tip "Hint 2"
    The agents act on history, not just live values. A forged reading steers the next few decisions.

??? tip "Hint 3"
    Inject a reading that makes the agents drain and then run the pump on a tank that is actually empty; the pump runs dry.

Still stuck? The [reference solution](solutions/C08.md) has the full attack and the fix
(spoilers).
